prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a highly polished, buildable WeChat Mini Program mobile UI screenshot for the Chinese home-visit wellness service brand "天俪". This is a first-round visual design, not an advertising poster.
OUTPUT: one complete flat mobile screen, portrait 9:19.5 aspect ratio, at least 1080 px wide. Edge-to-edge UI without phone hardware frame, perspective, floating panels, surrounding presentation board or external captions. Every UI element and every line must be sharp and readable. All Chinese is accurate simplified Chinese.
VISUAL SYSTEM: warm refined natural wellness; restrained and professional. Warm ivory background #F7F5EF; deep pine #173F35 primary; muted sage #DCE7DF secondary; sparing brass #B89A65; dark ink #252F2B; white content surfaces. Use Source Han Sans SC (思源黑体) for UI and Source Han Serif SC (思源宋体) only for the brand and a short editorial heading. Crisp 1.5px professional outline icons, no emoji. 8px spacing scale, 20px mobile screen gutters, 16px corner cards, 12px corner 48px-high buttons at logical 390px width. Small 1px warm gray dividers, almost no shadows. Clear large numerals. Subtle orange/red only for actionable warning statuses.
Top contains a realistic compact WeChat status bar showing 09:41, then nav bar with the WeChat capsule at right. Bottom includes an ample safe-area and hairline home indicator. Content is spaced realistically to fit one mobile viewport, no accidental cropping.
ALIGNMENT: All buttons, badges and compact tiles center their full content group both horizontally and vertically, with balanced padding. Buttons fit within the parent card with equal outer left/right insets. No clipped labels, overlapping content, or huge empty gaps.
SCOPE: phase 1 offers home visits only; all-in prices include travel. Never show in-store booking, coupons, discounts, membership, top-up, packages, promotion banners, medical diagnoses, treatment promises, live background location tracking, gambling-like rewards or payment settings. No false official certifications or medical claims. Photographic people wear modest professional uniforms; no exposed torsos or sensual spa styling.
Use exactly the requested text; do not invent extra features, numbers, badges, awards, slogans or lorem ipsum.
SCREEN: customer homepage. A warm welcoming service-led screen, with one quiet editorial photograph and a strong service-booking hierarchy.
LAYOUT FROM TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. Navigation: left brand "天俪" in refined serif with small secondary "上门保健"; right WeChat capsule. Below it an address row with location pin, "幸福里小区" and chevron, plus a small sage pill "可提供上门服务". Address text and scope status are clearly distinct.
2. A wide 178px-high editorial hero at logical width 350px. Left 56% ivory background, beautifully set two-line headline "把放松" / "留给自己", small description "专业技师上门 · 门店全程负责", and a modest pine text link "了解服务 →". Right 44% soft natural daylight still-life photograph of folded ivory towels, a pine green work bag, pale oak and a single olive branch. This is a card integrated into the UI, not a giant poster; no candles, bare skin or pseudo-medical instruments.
3. A slender horizontal three-part reassurance row with line icons and exact labels: "培训记录可查" | "门店负责" | "价格透明". No heavy tile boxes.
4. Heading "上门服务" with small right text "全部项目 ›". One large featured service card with a 96px square professional photo on left: fully clothed technician in a pine uniform using gentle shoulder pressure on a fully clothed seated adult, in a bright ordinary living room. Right text "舒缓放松", secondary "60分钟 · 全身放松", price "¥298", small text "一口价". Under both within same card a quiet line "已含上门交通费，无其他附加费用". One full-width pine button centered "立即预约".
5. Heading "附近技师" and right link "查看全部 ›". Two compact side-by-side technician entries, each a small circular professionally dressed headshot with restrained content; first "林师傅", "擅长肩颈放松", second "陈师傅", "擅长全身放松". A small centered outlined button "选择技师" in each tile. Do not add rating numbers or distance estimates.
6. Bottom white native-style tab bar, 3 items with outline icons: "首页" active pine, "订单", "我的". Equal width and centered icon-label groups. No promotional or administrator tab.
The overall screen must feel premium yet practical, calm but not empty. Only show the exact text above; do not add external title labels or page numbers.

1. Top nav: back chevron, centered "确认预约", WeChat capsule on right.
2. Pine/sage slim context panel, small check icon, exact title "就近安排，技师已选定"; secondary "付款前请确认服务信息". It must not imply payment has happened.
3. White location section with pin icon. Exact text: "上门地址", bigger "幸福里小区 2号楼", next line "8层 802室", then "王女士  138****8000". Right small "修改 ›". All within one neat card.
4. White service card. Small muted-green service still-life thumbnail at left; "舒缓放松", secondary "60分钟", price "¥298" right. Divider. A row labeled "预约时间", value "10月2日  14:00–15:00", right chevron. Then assigned technician row: circular headshot of a modest professional male in pine uniform, text "林师傅", small badge "就近安排", secondary "为你服务的技师"; discreet link "查看档案 ›". Under a divider the row "服务门店" and right "天俪·示例门店".
5. White price card titled "费用明细". Row "服务总价" and right "¥298.00". Pale sage informational strip with exactly "已含上门交通费，无其他附加费用". Total row bold "合计" and right bold pine "¥298.00". No coupon, travel-fee, membership or fee-reduction rows.
6. Plain compact explanatory block titled "预约须知" with two short lines "取消预约将按取消规则处理" and "服务信息与技师档案可在订单中查看". Small link "查看取消规则 ›". No preselected consent checkbox or intrusive form.
7. Fixed bottom footer above safe area: left small "应付" above large "¥298.00"; right wide pine button with WeChat outline payment icon and centered label "微信支付". Button includes icon+label as one centered group. The whole footer is within screen bounds and has balanced horizontal gutters. No bottom tab bar on this transactional page.
Use only exact text above. Clean hierarchy with modestly warm refined brand character; ensure the long fee text fits inside the strip and no action clips.

2. Compact dark pine summary strip, exactly 3 equal cells separated by hairline lighter dividers: "今日订单" value "4"; "待确认" value "1"; "已完成" value "1". White text with large numerals. Content groups centered.
3. Section heading "待确认订单" with small orange dot and count "1". White priority card with thin muted-amber left accent. Top left bold "舒缓放松 · 60分钟", top right warm orange badge "待接单". Next row "16:00–17:00". Next row location pin and "幸福里小区". A small amber timer row, clock icon and exact text "请在 08:42 内确认". Bottom equal-width centered buttons: left pale outlined "拒绝", right pine filled "确认接单". These two buttons share aligned heights and the same horizontal gutter.
4. Section heading "今日行程" with small right link "全部订单 ›". A white current service card: top "14:00–15:00", right sage badge "已出发"; next line "舒缓放松 · 60分钟"; next "雅园小区". Thin dotted three-step progress strip showing "已出发" as current then "待到达" then "待服务". Below a primary pine button "到达打卡" and an adjacent restrained outlined icon+label "导航". A quiet lower row: small phone icon "联系客户" at left, red outline shield icon "安全求助" at right. No map or always-on live location dot.
5. Slim white horizontal shortcut row with calendar icon "管理排班" and secondary "查看可接单时段" with chevron.

No withdraw-money shortcut or invented payout values on this screen. Keep enough space for all actions and the safe area without squeezing or overflow. Use only exact text above.

refinements.reason: 统一同名技师在不同页面的头像
refinements.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image 1 is the edit target: the complete 天俪 user homepage mobile screenshot.
Input image 2 is a portrait reference only: the technician workbench screenshot.
Make exactly one consistency correction to image 1's "附近技师" section at the bottom: the circular avatar beside the text "林师傅" must show the same male technician shown beside "林师傅" in image 2, wearing the same pine green professional uniform and using the same face and hair. The circular avatar beside "陈师傅" must show the female professional currently in image 1's left avatar, keeping her pine uniform.
Preserve EVERYTHING else in image 1: all exact Chinese text, names, numbers, font sizing, layout, colors, card sizes, hero photo, service photo, spacing, borders, all buttons, icons, status bar, bottom tab bar, screen dimensions and complete composition. Only replace the two circular headshots. Do not move the portraits or change their circular bounds. Do not alter text, resize the canvas, crop the screen, or add new visual elements.
Return one complete final flat mobile UI screenshot matching image 1 exactly except the corrected avatars.
